text:
Maya Patel: FYI customer ACME-0021's primary card declined this AM and ACH microdeposits still unverified. They have a Dedicated overage invoice for March we need to resolve to avoid suspension.

billing-bot: alert - payment failure for account ACME-0021. 1 card decline, ACH pending. Invoice INV-2026 created for $18,400.

Carlos Ramirez: Just reached out to support@acmehealth.com asking them to retry the card via the billing portal. Offered wire as backup.

Maya Patel: If they wire, finance needs to ok accepting it today to prevent auto-suspend. Wire can take 1-2 business days so card is preferred.

Nora Li: Do we have a PO or tax ID on file for them? Sophie, you mentioned a PO was in progress. If no PO we'll still accept wire but need billing contact + tax ID in the remittance email.

Sophie Chen: Procurement said PO is en route but likely not before end of day. Customer confirmed they can initiate a wire if we provide instructions and a remittance PDF.

Ivan Gomez: Proposed flow: 1) manual retry of the declined card (low-risk) 2) if that fails, provide wire instructions and mark invoice pending-wire 3) approve a 48-hour waiver to prevent automatic suspension. @Maya can you approve the hold?

Maya Patel: Approve 48-hour hold for ACME-0021. Record waiver and update invoice terms to avoid auto-suspend during that window.

Ivan Gomez: I'll do the manual retry now and report back. If it fails I'll send the wire details.

Ivan Gomez: Manual retry failed (card still declined). Moving to wire flow. Sending instructions and remittance PDF now.

Ivan Gomez: Wire instructions to send: 
Bank: First City Bank
Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Routing (ABA): 021000021
Account #: 123456789
SWIFT: FCBUS33
Reference: INV-2026 / ACME-0021
Note: please email remittance confirmation to billing@redwood.com

Carlos Ramirez: Customer replied asking for the remittance PDF with exact amount + invoice number. Can someone generate and drop it in shared drive?

Maya Patel: I'll create the remittance PDF and include the waiver note. I'll place it at /shared/finance/remittances/ACME-0021_INV-2026.pdf. Carlos, send that attachment along with the wire instructions.

billing-bot: invoice INV-2026 status updated -> hold_until: 48h from 1801002345 (waiver applied by Maya Patel).

Nora Li: Once funds land, please record the bank reference and update invoice status to Paid. Also attach PO when we receive it and update the customer record.

Sophie Chen: Noted. If they ask to prorate or pause Dedicated usage, escalate to product for guidance.

Maya Patel: Follow-up plan: if wire not initiated within 24 hours, schedule a quick call with procurement to unblock.

Carlos Ramirez: Email with remittance PDF and wire instructions sent. Customer acknowledged and said treasury will initiate wire today.

Ivan Gomez: Will monitor bank and update thread when funds post.

Maya Patel: Thanks team. Closing loop once payment cleared.
